content.title: How to Have a Conversation with Anyone
content.text: Learn How to Have a Conversation with Anyone in this free 4-part mini-class (with chapter markers!). Learn to start a conversation with confidence and keep the ball rolling naturally. You'll learn how to talk to people, how to feel comfortable, and how to feel confident talking to almost anyone. See lots of FREE resources on my webpage, including a free class on the Top 5 Essential Communication Skills for all Professionals https://www.alexanderlyon.com/free-re... Alex's COMMUNICATION COACH ACADEMY: https://www.alexanderlyon.com/cca Connect with Alex on LinkedIn: / alexlyoncommunicationcoach Communication Coach, this channel, helps rising leaders like you increase your impact and lead your teams with more excellence. The channel focuses on communication skills for leaders, presentation skills, group and team skills, and conversation skills. If you're looking for self-paced communication skills training, this is the channel for you. 00:00 Introduction 00:17 Part 1: Dos and Don'ts of Conversation 09:22 Part 2: How to Ask Great Questions 19:42 Part 3: How to Keep a Conversation Flowing Naturally 27:09 Part 4: Bonus Q&A Session 27:44 Q1: What if they don't ask me questions? 30:19 Q2: What if they don't seem to want to talk? 32:28 Q3: What if they won't stop talking? 43:29 Q4: When can I talk about what I want?
